chunks: This is the Paradise which We cause to inherit those of Our servants who were pious.
ai.seo_question: Who inherits Paradise according to Surah Maryam?
ai.summary: In Surah Maryam, this verse highlights the divine promise of Paradise as an inheritance specifically reserved for the *Taqi* (pious), reinforcing the Shia emphasis on *Taqwa* as the defining characteristic of true believers. It connects the concept of spiritual inheritance (*warathah*) to moral purity, suggesting that righteousness is not merely a state but a legacy passed down through generations of faithful servants.
